remarks.role: VC at FirstMarkCap.  Host: MAD Podcast; Organizer: Data Driven NYC, Author: MAD Landscape.
remarks.text:
Truly a win-win-win:

* NVIDIA is officially the center of open source AI w/ Nemotron and now HF

* Hugging Face scores huge + gets the perfect home (no more nagging re business model!)

* Open source AI wins!

Massive congrats to friends @ClementDelangue, @Thom_Wolf (+ @ctnzr!)

remarks.name: Matt Turck
remarks.role: VC at FirstMarkCap.  Host: MAD Podcast; Organizer: Data Driven NYC, Author: MAD Landscape.
remarks.text:
Fun to be in the guest chair (vs host), for once.  Chatted with Dan Nathan about:

* why the best venture firm in the world might be NVIDIA 
* the "hyper power law"
* why apps are becoming labs faster than labs are becoming apps
* RSI and "building God"
* AI bubble vs.duration mismatch concern
* Learning to stop underestimating China
remarks.translation: 坐在客座（而非主持）位置上，难得有趣。与丹·内森聊了聊：* 为什么全球最顶尖的风险投资公司可能是英伟达 * “超级幂律” * 为什么应用变成实验室的速度快于实验室变成应用 * RSI与“打造上帝” * AI泡沫与期限错配的担忧 * 学会不再低估中国

podcasts.originalExcerpt: A few years ago, Caltech Prof. and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, Anima Anandkumar set out to develop the first open-source weather model with AI. Talking to experts in the field, she was met with skepticism. Weather is chaotic, physics simulations are hard, have been developed for decades, and require supercomputers, the data just isn’t there. Despite reservations, Anima went forth and built. Within a year her team had developed FourCastNet, a predictive model that is competitive with the best physics-based simulations available. Thanks to Anima, and her follow up work, anyone can now predict weather accurately over a short timescale using consumer grade GPUs.
